title: AfroXLMR-Social: Adapting Pre-trained Language Models for African Languages Social Media Text

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (Macro F1 scores) on downstream social media tasks (sentiment analysis, emotion detection, and hate speech classification) before and after applying Domain Adaptive Pre-training (DAPT) and Task Adaptive Pre-training (TAPT) to mitigate the baseline models' pre-training data bias toward religious and news domains.

Comparing the performance of multilingual and African-centric language models across 19 low-resource African languages to evaluate disparities in language representation and downstream task capabilities compared to high-resource languages.
